enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket over body. Remains still. Occasionally turns from back to side. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering, brushing teeth and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up on bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes. Turns on shower. Adjusts water. Steps into shower. Washes body. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Dries with towel. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Gets dressed. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling kettle and making toast
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread, butter, jam. Closes refrigerator. Places bread in toaster. Presses lever. Fills kettle with water. Places kettle on stove. Turns on stove. Waits. Toaster pops. Removes toast. Spreads butter and jam. Pours boiling water into cup. Adds tea bag. Sits at table. Eats toast. Drinks tea. Picks up plate and cup. Places in sink. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing work bag and checking phone for the day's program schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up work bag. Opens bag. Places laptop, notebook, pen inside. Zips bag. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Checks schedule. Locks phone. Puts phone in pocket. Picks up bag. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit community office
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Stands and waits. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks to office building. Enters building. Walks to elevator. Presses button. Waits. Enters elevator. Presses floor button. Exits elevator. Walks to office door. Opens door. Enters office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator: team check-in, program planning and meeting community partners
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at desk. Turns on computer. Logs in. Checks emails. Opens calendar. Attends team check-in meeting. Greets colleagues. Sits at table. Discusses program updates. Takes notes. Returns to desk. Makes phone calls to community partners. Schedules meetings. Meets with partner in meeting room. Shakes hands. Discusses collaboration. Takes notes. Returns to desk. Reviews program plan. Edits document. Saves file. Prints copies.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to nearby cafe. Enters cafe. Stands in line. Orders sandwich and coffee. Pays. Receives food. Finds table. Sits down. Unwraps sandwich. Eats sandwich. Drinks coffee. Checks phone. Finishes meal. Throws trash. Returns tray. Walks back to office. Enters office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working: coordinating volunteers, preparing weekend community event materials and answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Makes phone calls to volunteers. Confirms schedules. Updates volunteer list. Opens event materials document. Edits document. Prints flyers. Gathers supplies. Packs boxes. Labels boxes. Sends emails to team. Attends brief meeting. Takes notes. Returns to desk. Checks task list. Completes tasks.

Walks to bus stop. Stands and waits. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks to home. Enters home. Closes door. Removes shoes. Puts down bag.

Walks to kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and meat. Closes refrigerator. Takes out pot. Places on stove. Turns on stove. Adds oil. Chops vegetables. Adds vegetables and meat to pot. Stirs. Adds spices. Covers pot. Washes salad. Places salad in bowl. Turns off stove. Serves food onto plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Picks up plate and places in sink. Turns off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Opens dishwasher. Loads plates. Loads cups. Loads utensils. Adds detergent. Closes dishwasher. Turns on dishwasher. Picks up sponge. Wets sponge. Applies soap. Wipes counter. Rinses sponge. Wipes stove. Wipes sink. Dries counter with towel. Picks up crumbs. Throws in trash. Turns off kitchen light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing: watching TV and winding down after work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Settles on show. Watches TV. Pauses to get snack. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out snack. Closes refrigerator. Walks to living room. Sits on couch. Eats snack. Continues watching TV. Turns off TV. Stands up. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer and reading to wind down for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Turns on computer. Logs in. Opens browser. Reads news. Checks social media. Closes browser. Shuts down computer. Closes laptop. Picks up book. Lies on bed. Opens book. Reads pages. Closes book. Places book on nightstand. Turns off desk lamp. Lies down.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Wets face. Applies cleanser. Rinses face. Dries face. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out.
Lies down on bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket over body. Remains still. Breathes slowly. Turns to side. Adjusts pillow. Continues sleeping.
